sql: SELECT T2.`Character Name` FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID WHERE T1.Title = 'Batman' ORDER BY T2.screentime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.Title FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T3.Name = 'Tom Cruise'

SELECT T2.`Character Name` FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T3.Name = 'Tom Cruise' AND T1.Title = 'Born on the Fourth of July'
SELECT AVG(T1.Rating) FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T3.Name = 'Tom Cruise'

SELECT (MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(T2.screentime, 3, 2) AS REAL)) - MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(T2.screentime, 3, 2) AS REAL))) * 100 / MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(T2.screentime, 3, 2) AS REAL)) FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID WHERE T1.Title = 'Batman'
SELECT T2.`Character Name` FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID WHERE T2.creditOrder = 1 AND T1.Genre = 'Thriller' ORDER BY T1.Rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T3.Name FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title = 'Batman' ORDER BY T2.screentime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.`Birth City` FROM characters AS T1 INNER JOIN actor AS T2 ON T1.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T1.`Character Name` = 'Gabriel Martin'
SELECT T3.Name FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title = 'American Hustle' AND T2.creditOrder = 2
SELECT T3.Name FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T1.`Release Date` = '2015-10-26' AND T2.creditOrder = 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.`Birth Country` = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T3.`Birth Country`) FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title = 'Mrs. Doubtfire'
SELECT Name FROM actor WHERE ActorID = 439 AND Gender = 'Male' AND Ethnicity = 'White'

SELECT T3.NetWorth, T3.`Date of Birth` FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title = 'Die Hard 2' AND T3.`Height (Inches)` BETWEEN 60 AND 65

SELECT T1.Gross FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(T3.NetWorth, ',', ''), '$', '') AS REAL) > 375000000 AND T1.Rating < 7 AND T1.Genre = 'Comedy'

SELECT T2.`Character Name` FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID INNER JOIN actor AS T3 ON T3.ActorID = T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title = 'Bruce Almighty' AND T3.`Birth City` = 'Sherman Oaks' AND T3.Gender = 'Female' AND T3.`Height (Inches)` * 100 > (SELECT AVG(`Height (Inches)`) FROM actor) * 50
SELECT name FROM course WHERE name IN ('Intro to BlockChain', 'Computer Network') ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM course WHERE credit < (SELECT credit FROM course WHERE name = 'Machine Learning Theory')
SELECT COUNT(prof_id) FROM prof WHERE popularity > (SELECT popularity FROM prof WHERE first_name = 'Zhihua' AND last_name = 'Zhou')
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN prof AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id WHERE T2.first_name = 'Sauveur' AND T2.last_name = 'Skyme'
SELECT T2.f_name, T2.l_name FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.capability = (SELECT MAX(capability) FROM RA)

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN registration AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE ((T1.f_name = 'Laughton' AND T1.l_name = 'Antonio') OR (T1.f_name = 'Willie' AND T1.l_name = 'Rechert')) AND T3.name = 'Machine Learning Theory' ORDER BY T2.sat DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM prof AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T3.f_name = 'Willie' AND T3.l_name = 'Rechert'
SELECT AVG(T3.gpa) FROM prof AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Ogdon' AND T1.last_name = 'Zywicki'
SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM student WHERE type = 'RPG'
SELECT f_name, l_name FROM student WHERE gpa = (SELECT MAX(gpa) FROM student)

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM prof AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T3.f_name = 'Oliy' AND T3.l_name = 'Spratling'

SELECT CASE grade WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS result FROM registration WHERE student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM student WHERE f_name = 'Rik' AND l_name = 'Unsworth') AND course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM course WHERE name = 'Computer Network')

SELECT T1.phone_number FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN registration AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T3.name = 'Intro to BlockChain' AND T2.grade = 'A'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.grade = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM registration AS T1 INNER JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id WHERE T2.name = 'Computer Network'

SELECT first_name, last_name FROM prof WHERE graduate_from IN ('Brown University', 'Columbia University', 'Cornell University', 'Dartmouth College', 'Harvard University', 'Princeton University', 'University of Pennsylvania', 'Yale University')
SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM student WHERE type = 'RPG'

SELECT T1.popularity FROM prof AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id WHERE T2.capability = (SELECT MAX(capability) FROM RA) GROUP BY T1.prof_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.student_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT prof_id, student_id FROM RA WHERE capability = (SELECT MIN(capability) FROM RA)
SELECT course_id, student_id FROM registration WHERE grade IS NULL OR grade = ''
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM prof

SELECT T3.f_name, T3.l_name, T2.capability, T3.gpa FROM prof AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Merwyn' AND T1.last_name = 'Conkay'

SELECT T3.f_name, T3.l_name, T2.capability FROM prof AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T1.graduate_from = 'University of Washington'

SELECT T5.name, T5.credit FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN prof AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T1.student_id = T3.student_id INNER JOIN registration AS T4 ON T3.student_id = T4.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T5 ON T4.course_id = T5.course_id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female' AND T2.teachingability = (SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof WHERE gender = 'Female')
SELECT T1.capability FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.type = 'RPG' AND T2.intelligence >= 4
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM registration AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.grade = 'B' AND T2.intelligence = 3
SELECT T1.name FROM course AS T1 INNER JOIN registration AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id WHERE T2.grade = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.salary = 'low' AND T2.gpa = 3.5
SELECT CAST(SUM(sat) AS REAL) / COUNT(course_id) FROM registration WHERE grade = 'B'

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name, T3.name FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN registration AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T1.intelligence = 5 AND T1.gpa < 3
SELECT AVG(T1.capability) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.gpa < 2.5

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name, T2.capability FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN registration AS T3 ON T1.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T3.grade IS NULL OR T3.grade = ''
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN prof AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id WHERE T1.salary = 'high' AND T2.teachingability = (SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof)

SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN registration AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T2.sat = 4 AND T1.gpa = 3.8 AND T3.name = 'Statistical Learning'

SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN registration AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T3.diff = 3 AND T1.intelligence = 2

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.type = 'UG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.type = 'RPG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.capability < 3
